description.value:
Cast 10 minutes

Frequency once per day

Cost 2 Vitae

Grow a small symbiotic creature from your own tissue to fight alongside you.

Grow a Small symbiotic creature from your own flesh. It acts on your initiative, using your proficiencies, has Hit Points equal to 5 times your level, and takes 1 action on your turn without you spending an action to command it. If it is reduced to 0 Hit Points it dissolves; you may regrow it the next time you spend 10 minutes and 2 Vitae. It cannot be more than 30 feet from you or it dissolves.

cinderfall.incomplete: Nothing this small creates a fully autonomous companion actor with independent HP and actions -- pf2e's real companion/eidolon systems are a much larger subsystem than a single rule element, and none of it is referenced here.
